name: Sciagent Skills
description: 197 ready-to-use life sciences skills that turn Claude into a domain expert for genomics, proteomics, drug discovery, biostatistics, scientific computing, and scientific writing. Each skill provides runnable code examples, key parameters with defaults, and troubleshooting guides for tools like Scanpy, RDKit, BioPython, PyMC, AutoDock Vina, and 190+ more. Scored 92.0% on BixBench-Verified-50 benchmark (+26.7%p over base Claude). Skills are auto-discovered — just describe your task and Claude finds the relevant skill.
longDescription:
Ships **135 skills**.

- **Skills** (135): `sciagent-skill-creator` (Scaffold a new SciAgent-Skills entry), `pymc-bayesian-modeling` (Bayesian modeling with PyMC 5: priors, likelihood, NUTS/ADVI sampling, diagnostics (R-hat, ESS), LOO/WAIC comparison, prediction), `scikit-survival-analysis` (Time-to-event modeling with scikit-survival: Cox PH (elastic net), Random Survival Forests, Boosting, SVMs for censored data), `statistical-analysis` (Guided statistical analysis: test choice, assumption checks, effect sizes, power, APA reporting), `statsmodels-statistical-modeling` (Python statistical modeling: regression (OLS, WLS, GLM), discrete (Logit, Poisson, NegBin), time series (ARIMA, SARIMAX, VAR), with rigorous…), `cellpose-cell-segmentation` (DL cell/nucleus segmentation for fluorescence and brightfield microscopy), `flowio-flow-cytometry` (Parse/write FCS (Flow Cytometry) files v2.0-3.1), `napari-image-viewer` (Interactive viewer for microscopy), and 127 more

Installs with `claude plugin install sciagent-skills@claude-community` from `jaechang-hits/SciAgent-Skills`.
